title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio Kiug-Ang, Municipality of Jasaan, Province of Misamis Oriental, to Luz
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio Kiug-Ang, Municipality of Jasaan, Province of Misamis Oriental, to Luz

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2196_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Barrio Kiug-ang in the Municipality of Jasaan, Province of Misamis Oriental is changed to Luz, to wit: Barrio Luz, Municipality of Jasaan, Province to Misamis Oriental.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: May 7, 1959.
